statement: You are given a singly linked list whose node values, read from head to tail, are listed in values.
Reverse the list in place so that every next pointer points the other way: the old tail becomes the new head and the old head becomes the new tail, pointing to null.
Return the reversed list, read from its new head.

examples.explanation: Each of the four links is flipped one at a time, so the last node, 4, ends up as the head.
All six links are flipped; 12, the former tail, is now the head and 7 points to null.

constraints: The number of nodes is in the range [0, 5000]
